newsitem.title: ITALY: Costa Crociere sees '96 sales, profits up.
newsitem.headline: Costa Crociere sees '96 sales, profits up.

text.p: Italian cruise line Costa Crociere SpA, which has agreed to be purchased by Airtours and Carnival Corp, forecast that its 1996 sales would rise 15 percent to 1.1 trillion lire and its net consolidated profit this year would be superior to that seen in 1995.
The Genoa-based company issued a statement giving these details after the announcement of a joint offer by Airtours and Carnival earlier today, valued at 452 billion lire or 181 million pounds.
The two prospective buyers said that in due course they expect to launch a joint tender offer which would make them 50-50 owners of Costa.
Italian stock market watchdog Consob said that Costa shares could resume trading later today after they were suspended on Monday pending the announcement.
